name: All Scrambled Up: An Eggman Dating Sim!
source:
Have you ever wondered what it'll be like to romance the one and only Dr. Eggman from the Sonic franchise?

No? Well, too bad- He has his own Dating Sim now.

[From [url=https://bonbonandfang.itch.io/all-scrambled-up-an-eggman-dating-sim]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你有没有想过，和《索尼克》系列独一无二的蛋头博士谈恋爱，会是什么感觉？

没有？那真遗憾——他现在可是有自己的恋爱模拟游戏了。
